system.description: After resting where you can reach a crowd — in person or through technology or magic — gain (SL + 1) Reputation Points, holding at most (SL + 3); start with 2 if taken at creation. In a non-conflict scene, spend 2 on meeting an NPC: they have heard of you, positively or negatively inclined — your choice which.
